## Overlap with 34cd worth resolving when both land

34cd's unpushed branch adds `voter.in_flight_reviews()` — a counter bracketed around
`review_and_vote`, counting BOTH the worker and the reconciler, exposed on `/health` for
autodeploy to poll. This change adds `reconcile.review_in_flight()`, counting the RECONCILER
only, used in-process by the lifespan.

They are independent by design (this fix cannot depend on unlanded work), but whichever lands
second should consolidate: a single counter in `voter` could serve both the `/health` field and
this drain gate. Note the two are not interchangeable as-is — the lifespan gate specifically
needs "is the RECONCILER mid-review", because a WORKER review in flight is already covered by
`queue.join()`, and gating on a combined count would make the reconciler wait redundant-but-
harmless rather than wrong. Flagged so the merge is deliberate rather than accidental.
